mentions.name: Berlin apartment rent map
mentions.description: This project analyzes around 30,000 Berlin apartment listings from the past year to help foreign apartment seekers rate a listing’s price, size and location and set realistic expectations — for example, showing how many matching listings appear per month and the odds of getting a flat. The first release is a map of median rent per square meter.
mentions.problem: Foreign apartment seekers in Berlin struggle to judge whether a listing’s price, size and location are reasonable and lack realistic expectations about their chances in the rental market.
mentions.audience: Foreign apartment seekers in Berlin who need help judging listings and setting realistic expectations about their rental search.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got access to around 30,000 Berlin apartment listings from the last year. The end goal to help foreign apartment seekers rate a listing’s price, size and location, and to give people realistic expectations.

evidence.value: I got access to around 30,000 Berlin apartment listings from the last year. The end goal to help foreign apartment seekers rate a listing’s price, size and location, and to give people realistic expectations.
